[[File:2x19_wicket_cookie.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]], an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] warrior apprentice, eating a cookie.]]
{{Quote|Yes, I ''did'' sit down and talk surrender terms with Loathsom, over a cup of tarine tea. He became most ungentlemanly when he realized it was ''his'' surrender we were talking about. Have these people no manners? He didn't even offer me a sweet-sand cookie.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, talking afterward about his surrender to Whorm Loathsom|<ref name="TCWN">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref>}}
A '''cookie''' was a small, flat-baked [[Cake/Legends|cake]].

[[Kal Skirata]] asked for a cookie during mealtime in an operation on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

A similar food, [[Wookiee-ookiee]]s were a type of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] commonly made by [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]].

The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] made cookies for themselves.

[[Sweet-sand cookie/Legends|Sweet-sand cookies]] were another sort of cookie.
